ussfcu_finance_turn_shutdown.ai_response: Modeled on our own members' behavior, not industry averages, which matters because our field of membership is concentrated in the Senate community. In a 30-day shutdown, an estimated 18% of affected members draw down deposits and about 6% delay a loan payment. Projected 60-day delinquency rises across unsecured consumer credit, led by the Home Improvement Loan book, and modeled loan losses increase about $4.2M over two quarters. Because this is calibrated to our members, the impact lands sharper and faster than a generic ALM shock would show. This is the scenario an ALM model alone would miss.
